question: Estimate the number of retail outlets ITC needs for full nationwide distribution of its FMCG portfolio.
idealClarificationQuestions: ITC FMCG portfolio: Bingo, Sunfeast, Aashirvaad, Fiama, Vivel, Engage, Mangaldeep, Yippee etc.? Yes — excludes cigarettes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Bingo + Sunfeast biscuits + Yippee noodles: kirana + modern trade = ~25 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Combined ITC's FMCG distribution reaches ~70 lakh+ unique outlets pan-India (with overlap across portfolio).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~70-75 lakh outlets for full ITC FMCG distribution.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: needs grocery + premium store distribution = ~30 lakh outlets.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Including cigarettes (separate channel — Pan, Tobacco, etc.)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~70-75 lakh outlets for full ITC FMCG distribution.

calculationFlow: - Aashirvaad atta + ghee: needs grocery + premium store distribution = ~30 lakh outlets.
- Bingo + Sunfeast biscuits + Yippee noodles: kirana + modern trade = ~25 lakh.
- Personal care (Fiama, Vivel, Engage, Charmis): ~20 lakh.
Combined ITC's FMCG distribution reaches ~70 lakh+ unique outlets pan-India (with overlap across portfolio).
Including cigarettes (separate channel — Pan, Tobacco, etc.): ~75 lakh unique + non-cigarette outlets.
Round: ~70-75 lakh outlets for full ITC FMCG distribution.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~70-75 lakh outlets for full ITC FMCG distribution.
